sentences.en: High-viscidity emulsion powder, dispersible in water . It can increase the adhesion between mortar and its substrates, and improve the mechanic property and constructability of mortar.

sentences.en: Tests show that the re - dispersible emulsoid powder can remarkably improve mechanical property and durability of mortar.
